# Bye.DS_Store v1.0.6

## What's New

- Merged the latest `dev` improvements into `main`.
- Added full-disk scan confirmation and detailed failure results.
- Added disk location selection, exclusion rule management, and cleanup status.
- Added Chinese, English, and System default language choices.
- Fixed Settings controls refreshing immediately after a language change.
- Added DMG packaging and optional Developer ID notarization.

## Notes

- Full-disk cleanup remains a manual operation.
- Without Apple Developer secrets, the release uses an ad hoc signed app.
